title: Beta
notes: Block library for a V4+/6b+ climber. Gym equipment only. No finger-strength work by design — fingers get trained on the wall.

exercises.name: Scap pull-ups
exercises.cue: Dead hang, arms straight. Pull shoulder blades down and together, hold 1s, release.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.cue: Full range, chest toward bar. Add weight once 8 clean reps feel easy (0 kg = bodyweight).

exercises.name: Ring / inverted rows
exercises.cue: Body in one line, pull rings to chest. Walk feet forward to make it harder.

exercises.name: Band pull-aparts
exercises.cue: Arms straight at shoulder height, squeeze shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: DB overhead press
exercises.cue: Press straight overhead without arching the lower back. Per-hand weight.

exercises.name: Dips or push-ups
exercises.cue: Dips if shoulders are happy, otherwise push-ups. Full depth, controlled down.

exercises.name: Face pulls
exercises.cue: Cable or band at face height. Pull toward ears, thumbs pointing back.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raises
exercises.cue: No swing. Knees to chest to start; straighten the legs as it gets easy.

exercises.name: Hollow body rocks
exercises.cue: Lower back pressed into the floor. Shrink the shape if the back pops up.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.cue: Cable/band at chest height, stand side-on. Press out slowly, resist the rotation.

exercises.name: 90/90 hip switches
exercises.cue: Sit tall, rotate both knees side to side without using hands.

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.cue: Heels down, chest up. Hold a post for balance if needed.

exercises.name: Elephant walks
exercises.cue: Fold forward, hands toward floor, alternate straightening one knee at a time.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.cue: Back foot up on a bench or wall, squeeze the glute, stay tall. Gentle — no forcing.

exercises.name: T-spine extensions on roller
exercises.cue: Roller across the mid-back, hands behind head, extend over it. Move the roller up a notch between reps.

exercises.name: Wall slides
exercises.cue: Forearms on the wall, slide up as high as possible while keeping contact.

exercises.name: Lat stretch on bar
exercises.cue: Grab a bar or post with one hand, sink the hips back and away.

exercises.name: Pec doorway stretch
exercises.cue: Forearm on the frame at shoulder height, step through gently.

exercises.name: Wrist extensor curls
exercises.cue: Light DB, palm down, forearm on knee. Lift the knuckles slowly. Antagonist for climbing forearms.

exercises.name: DB external rotation
exercises.cue: Lie on your side, elbow pinned to hip, rotate the forearm up slowly.

exercises.name: Rear-delt fly
exercises.cue: Hinge over, raise the DBs out to the sides, thumbs forward, no swinging.

library.name: Chin-ups
library.cue: Palms toward you. Full range, control the way down.

library.name: Lat pulldown
library.cue: Pull to the collarbone, chest tall, no leaning back for momentum.

library.name: Seated cable row
library.cue: Pull to the lower ribs, squeeze the shoulder blades, slow return.

library.name: Bench press
library.cue: Feet planted, bar to mid-chest, press up and slightly back.

library.name: Incline DB press
library.cue: Bench at ~30°. Press up and in, don't let the DBs drift out wide.

library.name: Lateral raises
library.cue: Soft elbows, raise to shoulder height, no shrugging.

library.name: Ab-wheel rollouts
library.cue: From knees. Ribs down, no lower-back sag — shorten the rollout if it arches.

library.name: Side plank
library.cue: Straight line ear to ankle, hips stacked and lifted.

library.name: Toes to bar
library.cue: Hang, lift the toes to the bar with control. Bend knees to scale.

library.name: V-ups
library.cue: Reach hands to feet, fold in the middle, lower slowly.

library.name: Back squat
library.cue: Brace, sit down between the heels, drive up. Depth before load.

library.name: Romanian deadlift
library.cue: Hinge at the hips, bar close to the legs, stop when the hamstrings say so.

library.name: Split squats
library.cue: Long stance, back knee toward the floor, front heel heavy.

library.name: Calf raises
library.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top. Useful for smearing and toe hooks.

library.name: Pigeon stretch
library.cue: Front shin across, hips square, fold forward only as far as comfortable.

library.name: Frog rocks
library.cue: Knees wide on the floor, rock hips back toward the heels and forward.

library.name: Deep lunge + rotation
library.cue: Low lunge, inside hand down, rotate the other arm to the ceiling. High-step opener.

library.name: Y-T-W raises
library.cue: Chest on an incline bench. 8 reps in each letter shape, thumbs up, light or no weight.

library.name: Cuban rotations
library.cue: Row up, rotate the forearms back, press overhead. Very light — quality only.

library.name: Wrist flexor stretch
library.cue: Palm flat on the bench, fingers toward you, lean back gently.
